# kloPIT

> Free open-source PIT-38 tax calculator for Polish investors using foreign brokers. Runs entirely in the browser — data never leaves the device.

kloPIT calculates Polish PIT-38 and PIT/ZG values from foreign-broker trades, dividends, NBP exchange rates and FIFO cost basis. Imported data stays locally in IndexedDB and is not sent to any server. AGPL-3.0, no signup, no tracking.

## Capabilities

- Import CSV from Interactive Brokers Activity Statements (trades, dividends, withholding tax, corporate actions).
- Import PDF from IBI Capital for ESPP and RSU grants with per-grant FIFO lots.
- Import CSV from Charles Schwab (ESPP deposits, RSU vests, sales). Schwab dividends and withholding: manual entry.
- Manual entry for trades, dividends and foreign withholding tax for any other broker.
- Capital gains via FIFO per ISIN and per broker account (art. 24 ust. 10 ustawy o PIT), with lot-level isolation for ESPP grants.
- NBP Table A average exchange rates from the business day preceding each transaction or dividend.
- Foreign dividend withholding credit capped per dividend at the lower of 19% and the bilateral tax-treaty rate.
- PIT-38 Section C (proceeds and costs), Section D (tax base and 19% tax), Section G (foreign dividends), Section H (total tax due).
- PIT/ZG per-country breakdown using ISIN country mapping.
- Loss carryforward over 5 years with the 50% annual cap.
- Carry-in positions across tax years.
- Symbol-to-country override table for treaty rate selection.

## Legal basis (ustawa o PIT)

Polish personal income tax act (ustawa z dnia 26 lipca 1991 r. o podatku dochodowym od osób fizycznych), consolidated text.

- art. 30b ust. 1 ustawy o PIT — 19% tax on income from the paid disposal of securities and derivatives (capital gains)
- art. 30b ust. 5a–5b ustawy o PIT — deduction of tax paid abroad on that income, limited to the proportional part of the Polish tax
- art. 30b ust. 6 ustawy o PIT — annual return for this income: the return under art. 45 ust. 1a pkt 1 (PIT-38)
- art. 45 ust. 1 i ust. 1a pkt 1 ustawy o PIT — filing window 15 February – 30 April of the following year; a separate return for art. 30b income
- art. 30a ust. 1 pkt 4 ustawy o PIT — 19% flat tax on dividends and other income from a share in the profits of legal persons
- art. 30a ust. 9 ustawy o PIT — deduction of tax paid abroad on dividends, capped at the tax at 19%
- art. 11a ust. 1–2 ustawy o PIT — foreign-currency income and costs converted at the NBP average rate from the last business day before the income or cost date
- art. 24 ust. 10 ustawy o PIT — FIFO when the purchase price cannot be identified, applied separately for each securities account
- art. 9 ust. 3 ustawy o PIT — loss carryforward: 5 years, at most 50% of the loss per year, or a one-off deduction of up to 5 000 000 zł

## Disclaimer

kloPIT is not an official tax administration tool and does not constitute legal or tax advice. Verify all results before filing your declaration.
